title: Disk sizing and online resize
summary: macOS and Linux test machines need at least 40 GiB on the volume holding the test home and temporary directories: OS, desktop and Chromium, a 3-4 GiB home, one golden plus a second home-sized copy during capture, harness installs, mission scratch and the 1 GiB mission admission floor. test_machine_disk_space_low recovery points at the Machine QA Pack's disk sizing section, which grows a disk online without a reboot: AWS modify-volume, then growpart and resize2fs or xfs_growfs on Linux, or diskutil repairDisk and apfs resizeContainer on an EC2 Mac, each through yoke test-machine exec --admin. A physical Mac cannot grow and frees space or moves.
